scope: Read-only local source, identity, frozen-input and launch-schema audit. No remote GPU, heavy IO, model, CUDA or NVML observation.

CURRENT_and_activation.meaning: Source identity only. The false run-record field is preserved and does not assert an experiment, environment, asset or GPU gate.

frozen_inputs.paired_distribution: Exactly once for each of four source IDs x two versions x two strategies x two repeats; expected first eight S0908 cells retained.
frozen_inputs.resident_contract: Four unique original sources, five model_sources including original warmup; fixed order at repeat 0 and reverse at repeat 1; same original frames/hashes and request clocks.
frozen_inputs.precision_and_frontiers: float32, max_ahead_frames=32000, maximum_service_seconds=240, D2=2, C8=8, all offered frontiers including original EOS preserved.
frozen_inputs.FREEZE_RECEIPT_source_dev_path: Historical generation provenance; not the active immutable execution path. Its commit and manifest bytes match the immutable checkout.

controller_enforced: Exact controller commit and complete manifest, exact no-argument source receipt hash and matching controller identity
Exact frozen environment hash, current interpreter and package versions
Asset gate file SHA, PASS status, all_asset_bytes_verified=true, exact frozen asset_manifest_sha256
Dependency commits/manifests/clean byte-matched checkouts, exact config hashes and immutable input/warmup audio hashes
Reference hashes and PASS gate; actual pre-cell GPU-empty check; actual worker READY precision/counts/warmup/board/allocator gates
prelaunch_schema_review.explicit_gap: The frozen validate_plan schema does not consume formal Linux CPU28 or real orphan-group control receipts. These prerequisites currently depend on the root-owned execution wrapper, not the controller schema.

required_wrapper_binding_before_GPU_laun.formal_CPU_gate: Bind path+SHA, exact a13 controller commit and manifest hash, actual frozen Linux interpreter/environment, exact test names and 28 passed/0 failed result; verify before launch.
required_wrapper_binding_before_GPU_laun.real_orphan_OS_gate: Bind path+SHA, exact source commit, status PASS_REAL_LINUX_DEAD_LEADER_ORPHAN_GROUP_CONTROL, actual_group_SIGKILL=true and confirmed_no_executing_members=true. Preserve GPU_or_NVML_checked=false and CUDA_owner_query_was_synthetic=true.
required_wrapper_binding_before_GPU_laun.live_asset_gate: Bind path+SHA to an actual full-byte verification of the exact frozen asset manifest; all_asset_bytes_verified=true must be a measured result, not a copied historical flag.
required_wrapper_binding_before_GPU_laun.source_identity_receipt: Stage the exact activation/noarg receipt bytes and hash; compare commit/manifest and CURRENT hash to this audited generation before launch. A later CURRENT change requires a new receipt, not relabelling this receipt.

prelaunch_schema_review.implementation_location: Root-owned staging/launch wrapper may enforce these additional prerequisites without changing a13 or the frozen 36 configs.

not_verified_in_this_audit: Current remote interpreter/packages, GPU ownership and actual model READY
Any serving, task, timing, energy or natural fault-prevalence result
decision: No local source/config identity blocker. Retain pending status until the root-owned wrapper verifies and records the formal Linux/asset/environment/GPU prerequisites. Do not treat this local audit as GPU launch evidence.
